jobs.title: Senior Civil Engineer
jobs.description:
DLR Group is an integrated design firm with a promise to elevate the human experience through design. This fuels the work we do around the world and inspires our mission to improve the lives of our clients, our communities, and our planet. If this sparks your interest, you’re in the right place.

The Engineering team has an opening for a Senior Civil Engineer.

Location
: Los Angeles, CA

Position Summary

As a Civil Engineer you will be responsible for working in a dynamic and multidisciplinary design team to produce civil engineering designs on a variety of projects for mixed-use, commercial, educational, sports, hospitality and municipal buildings of all sizes and complexities, along with other site development opportunities.

If you are a collaborative designer with a strategic mindset this is the position for you. DLR Group is 100% employee owned and as such you’ll enjoy the opportunity to have ownership in the Firm. We rely on all our employee-owners to apply their financial acumen to grow the Firm profitably.

The Successful Candidate Will

Collaborate with architects, other engineers, and clients as part of our integrated design process.
Design, coordinate and prepare site development documents, utilizing Autodesk’s Civil 3D software, throughout project development on a wide variety of projects. Documentation will include site layouts, horizontal and vertical control, grading and drainage, storm sewer and stormwater management design, paving, site utilities and associated civil engineering design deliverables.
Perform complex assignments, using best judgment in the evaluation, selection and implementation of civil engineering techniques.
Independently perform civil calculations, including code research.
Prepare detailed engineering reports, narratives and jurisdiction permitting applications.
Write and review specifications.
Review shop drawings and other construction related correspondence.
Conduct site visits as needed.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering.
Licensed Professional Civil Engineer (PE) in the State of California.
8+ years of civil engineering experience, focused on site development related to buildings.
Previous experience working in an A/E and / or Civil Engineering design firm.
An appreciation and understanding of the integrated design process and a desire to work collaboratively with multiple disciplines across multiple sectors.
Proficient with Autodesk Civil 3D. 
Working knowledge of additional current civil engineering related software (Hydraflow, Storm and Sanitary Sewer Analysis, InfraWorks, HecRAS).
Strong communication skills, verbal and written.
Strong understanding of storm water management requirements and hydrologic design.
Experience working on multiple projects at a time, and ability to set priorities to meet all project goals and schedules.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience and interest in sustainable site design and low-impact strategies.
Knowledge of ArcGIS Software
Knowledge of SketchUp or other rendering software for site plan presentations.
Experience with permit submission and approval processes for state agencies (DSA, OFSM, HCAI).
Experience leading a team of Civil Engineers and Designers to effectively deliver projects.

Our comprehensive Benefits at DLR Group include medical, dental, vision, disability, wellness programs, flex spending, paid holidays, and paid time off. We also offer a 401(k) plan, employee stock ownership, and bonus opportunities. Compensation considerations are based on location, experience, and skills. The suggested pay range for this position is:

Pay Range

$130,000 - $170,000 USD

DLR Group is an integrated design firm delivering architecture, engineering, interiors, planning, and building optimization for new builds, renovations, and adaptive reuse projects.

We are 100% employee-owned: every employee is literally invested in our clients’ success. At the core of our firm are interdisciplinary teams engaged in every step of project lifecycles. Our teams champion true collaboration, open information sharing, shared risk and reward, value-based decision making, and proficient use of technology to deliver exceptional design. We are pursuing the goals of the 2030 Challenge, the ME2040, and the SE2050, and are an initial signatory of the China Accord and the AIA 2030 Commitment.

Through our values – commitment, creativity, environmental stewardship, fun, integrity, ownership, sharing, teamwork – we elevate the human experience through design, together.

DLR Group follows a four-day in-office work model, with employees having the flexibility to work somewhere other than the office on Fridays.

jobs.title: Data Analyst II - Medical Informaticist
jobs.description:
1162515_RR00120318 Job ID: 1162515_RR00120318

NYU Grossman School of Medicine is one of the nation's top-ranked medical schools. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.

For more information, go to med.nyu.edu , and interact with us on LinkedIn , Glassdoor , Indeed , Facebook , Twitter and Instagram .

Position Summary

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Analyst II - DataCore.

NYU Langone Health seeks a Data Analyst - Medical Informaticist to support the design, curation, harmonization, and analysis of clinical data assets used for observational research, cohort discovery, phenotyping, and evidence generation across the enterprise. This role sits within the Medical Center Information Technology (MCIT) and is intended for candidates with strong healthcare data management, clinical informatics, and analytic programming skills who can help transform complex EHR and research data into research-ready datasets, validated cohorts, and reproducible evidence workflows.

The position is designed for analysts with deep familiarity with Epic and related EHR data ecosystems, OMOP Common Data Model environments, clinical data warehouses, tumor registry data, clinical notes, and standard biomedical vocabularies. The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering and analytic capability in Python, R, SQL, and related tools with practical experience in ontology-based harmonization, metadata management, data quality assessment, and cohort-based observational studies using heterogeneous real-world data sources.

This role also values candidates who can work effectively in modern AI-enabled analytic environments. Experience using AI coding assistants and development tools such as GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, or related platforms to accelerate analytic programming, ETL development, documentation, code review, and quality assurance is highly relevant to success in this position.

Job Responsibilities

Clinical Data Curation and Real-World Evidence Support

Build and maintain research-ready clinical datasets for observational studies, cohort characterization, computable phenotyping, and real-world evidence generation.

Extract, transform, and curate data from Epic and related institutional data sources, including structured EHR data, tumor registry assets, clinical documentation, laboratory data, medication data, pathology, imaging-linked metadata, and other relevant clinical systems.

Support cohort identification, patient screening, longitudinal outcome tracking, and registry-style data assembly for clinical and translational research use cases.

Develop reproducible workflows for data extraction, transformation, curation, and handoff to downstream analytics, reporting, and data science teams.

OMOP, Standards, and Ontology-Based Harmonization

Map institutional source data to standard terminologies and analytic data models including OMOP Common Data Model and related OHDSI ecosystem approaches.

Support terminology mapping and ontology-based harmonization using vocabularies such as SNOMED CT, ICD-10-CM, LOINC, CPT, RxNorm, HGNC, HPO, and related clinical and biomedical standards.

Develop and maintain ETL logic, concept mapping workflows, metadata definitions, source-to-target specifications, and semantic crosswalks needed for interoperable analytics.

Contribute to metadata management, lineage tracking, provenance documentation, and harmonization practices that improve reproducibility, transparency, and secondary use of clinical data.

Phenotyping, Cohort Logic, and Outcomes Data

Translate clinical and research concepts into computable phenotype definitions, cohort rules, variable definitions, and executable data queries.

Support development of phenotype and outcome datasets using structured EHR data, registry information, and clinical text-derived variables when appropriate.

Curate gold-standard outcomes and other validation datasets for research, quality assessment, and analytic model support.

Assist in cohort characterization, subgroup definition, temporal event sequencing, and longitudinal data assembly for observational analyses.

Data Quality, Validation, and Research Readiness

Perform data quality assessment across source and curated datasets, including completeness, plausibility, duplication, temporal consistency, semantic accuracy, and conformance to expected standards.

Implement validation checks and quality assurance workflows that identify anomalies, mapping issues, transformation errors, and inconsistencies that could affect research validity.

Conduct chart review support, targeted validation studies, and discrepancy analysis for phenotype definitions, outcomes, and derived variables.

Document transformation logic, assumptions, and validation results to support auditability, reproducibility, and compliant research operations.

Collaboration and Enablement

Collaborate with MCIT engineers, clinical informaticians, analysts, researchers, data scientists, and operational teams to define requirements and deliver fit-for-purpose analytic datasets.

Support observational studies, registry analyses, comparative effectiveness workflows, and precision medicine or trial-support use cases by providing curated data, cohort logic, and analytic context.

Contribute to dashboards, cohort reports, operational tracking outputs, and analyst-facing documentation that improve data usability across teams.

Apply efficient coding and workflow practices, including appropriate use of AI coding tools, to improve productivity, maintainability, and analytic quality.

Minimum Qualifications

To qualify you must have a Education

Bachelors degree in Biomedical Informatics, Health Informatics, Data Science, Biostatistics, Computer Science, Public Health, Epidemiology, or related field required; Masters degree preferred.

Experience

3+ years of relevant experience working with clinical, observational, or research data in a health system, academic medical center, payer, life sciences, or related healthcare environment.

Demonstrated experience with Epic or comparable EHR data ecosystems, clinical data warehouses, and research-oriented data extraction and curation.

Experience working with OMOP Common Data Model, OHDSI tools or methods, or other common clinical research data models is strongly preferred.

Experience supporting cohort definition/identification, phenotyping, registry-style datasets, chart review workflows, data quality assessment, or observational analytics.

jobs.description:
GENERAL DUTIES

Supports research projects and activities in connection with CUNY programs

May assist faculty research groups by configuring and testing equipment, collecting and organizing data, and preparing documentation.
Performs direct research tasks under supervision.
May develop or utilize computer-based systems to collect and analyze data.
May assist in preparing reports of research findings.

CONTRACT TITLE

Research Assistant

FLSA

Non-exempt

CAMPUS SPECIFIC INFORMATION

The Graduate Center of the City University of New York (CUNY) is the focal point for advanced teaching and research at CUNY, the nation's largest urban public university. With over 35 doctoral and master's programs of the highest caliber, the Graduate Center fosters pioneering research and scholarship in the arts and sciences and prepares students for careers in universities and the private, nonprofit, and government sectors. The Graduate Center's commitment to research and scholarship for the public good is exemplified by its more than 30 centers, institutes, and initiatives, including its Advanced Science Research Center (ASRC), a 200,000 square-foot facility in upper Manhattan, designed to promote collaboration among scientists in five areas of global research and innovation: nanoscience, photonics, structural biology, neuroscience, and environmental sciences.

The Graduate Center (GC) benefits from highly ambitious and diverse students and alumni-who in turn teach hundreds of thousands of undergraduates every year. Through its public programs, the Graduate Center enhances New York City's intellectual and cultural life.

A Research Assistant position is available in the laboratory of Dr. J. Wren Kim at the Neuroscience Initiative of the Advanced Science Research Center (ASRC).

Our laboratory seeks to understand the cellular and molecular mechanisms underlying neuronal adaptation to changing environments and how these processes contribute to brain function and dysfunction. Using innovative high-throughput approaches, we investigate how neurons regulate gene expression to maintain homeostatic control of neuronal network activity.

The laboratory is embedded within the vibrant and multidisciplinary research environment of the ASRC Neuroscience Initiative, where multiple research groups share laboratory space, resources, and expertise. We strongly value collaboration, the open exchange of ideas, and interdisciplinary approaches to scientific discovery. The ASRC provides access to state-of-the-art facilities, advanced instrumentation, and dedicated scientific support staff, creating an exceptional environment for training and research.

This position requires the incumbent to work in the lab Monday-Friday.

Research (75%):

Conduct independent and collaborative research experiments under the supervision of the Principal Investigator (PI).
Apply techniques in biochemistry, cell biology, molecular biology, and related disciplines.
Perform cell culture, molecular cloning, protein and nucleic acid analyses, and other experimental procedures as required.
Maintain accurate and detailed records of experimental procedures, data, and findings.

Laboratory Support (25%):

Assist the PI with managing laboratory inventory, including ordering and tracking reagents, consumables, and equipment.
Assist with preventative maintenance and repairs of lab equipment as needed.
Assist with onboarding and training of new laboratory members on standard procedures.
Maintain laboratory organization and ensure compliance with institutional safety regulations.
Adhere to standards for safety and hygiene and ethical conduct as defined by the University and relevant outside parties.
Perform related duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience relevant to the research being performed.

Other Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications:

Prior laboratory research experience in molecular and cellular biology is essential.
Experience working with rodents.
Flexibility in work schedule to accommodate experimental needs.
Willingnessto work both independently and collaboratively in a research environment.
Interest in contributing to a dynamic and multidisciplinary research program.

jobs.description:
1165063_RR00123259 Job ID: 1165063_RR00123259

NYU Grossman School of Medicine is one of the nation's top-ranked medical schools. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.

For more information, go to med.nyu.edu , and interact with us on LinkedIn , Glassdoor , Indeed , Facebook , X and Instagram .

Position Summary

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Senior Research Technician.

This Senior Research Technician position involves supporting a Senior Research Scientist by independently executing molecular biology operations. The ideal candidate has a strong background in nucleic acid (DNA/RNA) extractions from diverse sample types and will play a vital role in executing the extractions, troubleshooting workflows, and maintaining the molecular laboratory.

Job Responsibilities

Performs various experiments under the guidance of the Senior Research Scientist, including DNA/RNA extractions from various biomaterial (biofluid and tissue, etc) and Quality Control (QC), as well as Cytokine assays.
Maintains accurate and detailed experimental records as required by the Senior Research Scientist.
Ensures timely and accurate completion of research projects and data delivery.
Reports any issues encountered during experiments promptly and conduct troubleshooting under the guidance of the Senior Research Scientist.
Maintains and calibrates laboratory instruments, and coordinates routine upkeep, troubleshooting, service requests, and related documentation as needed.
Maintains laboratory supplies, reagents, and inventory; monitors stock levels and requests orders as needed.
Coordinates for specimens data entry in database (LabVantage/FileMaker Pro).
Adheres to department policies and procedures, including HIPAA and CAP accreditation requirements.
Performs other related duties as assigned.
Communications/ Relationships with others - Provides guidance, cooperates, communicates and relates well to all levels of NYU Langone Health Staff. Listens carefully to others in order to respond appropriately, answer questions or obtains needed information. Communicates ideas, problems, suggestions, and messages in a timely and effective manner. Maintains confidentiality of all research information. Maintains excellent and professional-level communication skills in oral and written English.
Judgement/ Decision making - Is able to recognize problems as they occur; and through the application of appropriate policy/ procedure, determines and/or recommends the appropriate solution. Seeks guidance as necessary for the performance of duties; asks appropriate questions when in doubt and utilizes reference sources/materials to ensure accuracy. Advises appropriate personnel of situations/problems requiring intervention or follow-up attention.

Minimum Qualifications

To qualify you must have a Bachelor's of Science Degree in Life Sciences or a related field with three years of experience. Specialization in three or more laboratory procedures is required. A solid foundation in basic lab protocols as well as significant experience in areas such as procedures is essential and required. Possess the knowledge and experience in specific areas such as Biochemistry, Histology, Molecular Biology, Immunology, etc.

In lieu of education, at least 10 years of related experience in a lab setting. A solid foundation in basic lab protocols as well as significant experience in areas such as procedures is essential and required. Possess the knowledge and experience in specific areas such as Biochemistry, Histology, Molecular Biology, Immunology, etc.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelors degree in molecular biology, genetics, or a related health science

discipline with 2-4 years of wet-bench experience in research. Has a thorough and proven proficiency in

handling multiple extraction techniques and molecular biology protocols. Strong organizational skills,

detailed-oriented record-keeping, and the ability to work independently.

Qualified candidates must be able to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization.

NYU Grossman School of Medicine provides its staff with far more than just a place to work. Rather, we are an institution you can be proud of, an institution where you'll feel good about devoting your time and your talents. At NYU Langone Health, we are committed to supporting our workforce and their loved ones with a comprehensive benefits and wellness package. Our offerings provide a robust support system for any stage of life, whether it's developing your career, starting a family, or saving for retirement. The support employees receive goes beyond a standard benefit offering, where employees have access to financial security benefits, a generous time-off program and employee resources groups for peer support. Additionally, all employees have access to our holistic employee wellness program, which focuses on seven key areas of well-being: physical, mental, nutritional, sleep, social, financial, and preventive care. The benefits and wellness package is designed to allow you to focus on what truly matters. Join us and experience the extensive resources and services designed to enhance your overall quality of life for you and your family.

NYU Grossman School of Medicine is an equal opportunity employer and committed to inclusion in all aspects of recruiting and employment. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration. We require applications to be completed online.

Oppenheimer & Co. Inc. (“Oppenheimer”) is a leading middle-market investment bank and full-service broker-dealer. Job Description

The firm is currently seeking a research associate to support our Cloud & Communications team covering Digital Infrastructure; Satellite and Communications. The position is located in New York City.

The research associate will work in conjunction with and support the lead analyst and another research associate on the team on all aspects of developing and marketing equity research products, including research reports, models, and industry analysis.

The position demands independence, initiative, and entrepreneurship, as the associate will gain responsibility over a broad array of report writing, model building, and other product maintenance duties. Attention to detail, strong work ethic, ability to multi-task and excellent communication skills are critical. The ideal candidate will have a background in accounting, an understanding of how technology and artificial intelligence operate, and a passion to uncover details to aid in the creation of research. Our ideal candidate is fully FINRA registered (SIE, Series 7, 63, 86, 87) and possesses 1-2 years of equity research or accounting experience with an interest in technology, though we will consider all qualified candidates.

In addition to the above, we look for people who possess, or have the potential to possess, the following characteristics:

Strong writing and analytical skills. Associates are responsible for writing and producing equity research reports, company initiations, and marketing presentations—often under very tight time constraints
Strong financial modeling, accounting, valuation, and quantitative skills. Associates are responsible for building and maintaining integrated I/S, B/S, and C/F models and for organizing and maintaining industry data. Attention to detail is critical
It is highly advantageous to have a passion for and exposure to the financial markets and equity research, as well as the day-to-day responsibilities of an equity research associate;
Strong sales and communication skills. As time progresses, associates will interact with internal sales and trading and external clients. Responsiveness and professionalism are important
Ability to work independently and initiate and accomplish projects with minimal supervision. Aggressive self-starters with a strong work ethic are desirable
Ability to organize, prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously
PC skills: the position requires strong Excel skills and a fair command of Word, PowerPoint, Bloomberg and FactSet

You will utilize your skills, knowledge, and clinical judgement to provide a high standard of care for participants in clinical trials and respond to emergency situations based upon clinical research standards.

Responsibilities

Responsible for all aspects of study site monitoring including routine monitoring and close-out of clinical sites, maintenance of study files, conduct of pre-study and initiation visits; liaise with vendors; and other duties, as assigned -
Responsible for all aspects of site management as prescribed in the project plans
General On-Site Monitoring
Ensure the study staff who will conduct the protocol have received the proper materials and instructions to safely enter patients into the study
Ensure the protection of study patients by verifying that informed consent procedures and protocol requirements are adhered to according to the applicable regulatory requirements
Ensure the integrity of the data submitted on Case Report Forms (CRFs) or other data collection tools by careful source document Monitor data for missing or implausible data

Perform other duties as assigned by management

University or college degree, or certification in a related allied health profession from an appropriately accredited institution (e.g. nursing licensure)

60% overnight travel

Fast paced: where no deviations from the study protocol are allowed, and not meeting a timeline for even few minutes will create a quality issue.

Teamwork and people skills are essential for the study to run smoothly.
Technology based. We collect our data directly into an electronic environment.

jobs.description:
Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Recruiting for this role ends on December 5, 2026

Work you'll do

As an AI and Data Science Engineer III on the Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team, you will be responsible for...

Translating business goals into machine learning use cases and model design approaches.
Performing exploratory data analysis to identify relationships, opportunities to influence outcomes, and cross-channel attribution patterns.
Applying clustering, sampling, feature transformation, and predictive modeling techniques to develop and refine solutions.
Building proofs of concept, interpreting model results, and validating that solutions perform as intended.
Collaborating with clients and cross-functional teams, including analytics and data engineering teams, throughout solution development and delivery.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree in engineering, mathematics, physics, machine learning, statistics, computer science, or another quantitative field
5+ years of industry experience outside of academia applying data science or machine learning methods
Experience translating business goals into machine learning use cases and model design
Experience performing exploratory data analysis and developing predictive models
Ability to travel 30%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

Master's degree in engineering, mathematics, physics, machine learning, statistics, computer science, or another quantitative field
Experience manipulating large marketing data sets and performing extract, transform, and load activities
Experience with boosted trees, logistic regression, classification techniques, unsupervised models, large language models, or experimental design
Experience with data sets generated in advertising technology or marketing technology environments
Experience presenting complex data insights to non-technical audiences
Experience with deep learning architectures or reinforcement learning

jobs.title: Data Science and Business Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to :

Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution
Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

This position is an onsite opportunity in the Abbott Diabetes Care Division. We are helping people with Diabetes lead healthier, happier lives. As a global leader in diabetes care, Abbott is constantly working to deliver the highest quality products and unwavering support to our customers. Consistent and accurate glucose monitoring is the foundation of any diabetes management plan, so we’re committed to continuous improvement in the way patients and professionals measure, track and analyze glucose levels.

As a Business Insights Manager, you will join a very welcoming team cultivating co-elevation principles. He/she will take a leadership role in the development and communication of key performance indicators and strategic analyses for key stakeholders. You will be supported as well as rewarded for your performance in a dynamic environment offering opportunities for development and growth. We recognize that people come from diverse backgrounds and skills and welcome all to apply. This is an onsite opportunity in Alameda, CA.

What You’ll Do

Data Science

Work within an agile team in a dynamic, fast-moving, collaborative environment and design complex analytics models and algorithms that drive analytical solutions throughout the organization
Develop statistical and machine learning models, leveraging expertise in classification, regression, clustering, and time series methodologies.
Perform causal inference analysis and study design, applying methods such as Difference-in-Differences, Synthetic Control, and geo experiments.
Analyze large amounts of data to discover trends and patterns, and build analytics models
Effectively communicate complex ideas and results to both technical and business/executive audiences
Conduct advanced statistical and other analysis to provide actionable insights, identify trends, and measure performance
Create repeatable, interpretable, dynamic, and scalable models that are seamlessly incorporated into analytics data products

Data Analytics

Proactively conduct quantitative and qualitative data analyses around ambiguous problems leveraging large data sets (incl. prescription, medical claims and/or longitudinal patient-level data)
Build models and automated dashboards to monitor and optimize business performance, address business questions, inform business decisions, and develop revenue forecasts
Optimize the impact of data and drive efficiency through advancement of analytical tools
Ensure data and analysis accuracy and timely completion of deliverables while managing multiple projects
Perform data analysis in local data warehouse environments using advanced SQL.
Maintain and update reports and dashboards within current data platforms.

Strategic Insights & Problem Solving :

Become a subject matter expert, trusted advisor, and source of truth for the ADC organization
Interpret data trends and present data-driven strategic insights and actionable recommendations to senior leadership related to business performance, operations, and customer insights
Formulate analytical strategies for proactively addressing customer needs, solving business problems, achieving commercial and marketing objectives, and developing new business opportunities

Teamwork and Collaboration :

Partner with internal (e.g., commercial, marketing, and finance) and external (e.g., vendors & agencies) stakeholders to align on business objectives, expectations, timelines, and action plan
Effectively communicate and actively collaborate within and beyond the team to cultivate teamwork and empowered partnerships
Create an open environment built on trust, candor, and co-elevation principles
Take accountability and offer help and support to colleagues

Required

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE YOU’LL BRING

Bachelors Degree In a Related field or an equivalent combination of education and work experience
Minimum 9 years of related work experience.
5+ years experience in commercial or market analytics desired, preferably in the healthcare industry in a market science or business analytics role.
Proficiency in using machine learning to solve clustering, classification, regression, anomaly detection, simulation, and optimization problems on large-scale data sets
Strong hands-on experience and expertise in one or more big data technologies, i.e., Hadoop, Spark, H20.ai, cloud AI platforms, containerization
Experience with enterprise market analytics, data management/mining, financial modeling, and market forecasting to measure business performance (KPIs) and marketing tactics effectiveness
Experience utilizing big data sets with medical claims and/or longitudinal patient-level information
Proven ability to manage multiple tasks concurrently under aggressive timelines in a dynamic and ambiguous environment
Strong strategic thinking, executive presence capabilities, and attention to detail
Advanced communication and presentation skills including ability to create impactful power point presentations with visual storytelling and adjust the story/details based on the audience
Deep understanding of latest analytical tools and dashboarding technologies, data warehousing, software, process, and applications (e.g., SQL, Tableau, AWS, Python, Machine Learning, Predictive Analytics, etc.)

Preferred

MBA, MS Degree in Business, Finance, Data Science, or Statistics
Strategic Consulting Experience
Experience in diabetes, CGM, or metabolic health; medical device commercial analytics experience is a strong plus
Experience with healthcare claims data (Dx, Px, Rx, and remittance) is a plus but not required.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI and Tableau is preferred.
Strong understanding of data architecture, with experience in Amazon Redshift and PostgreSQL as a plus.
Having familiarity with Amazon SageMaker and AWS is a plus.
Understanding of advanced and predictive analytics techniques used in marking mix modeling, segmentation analysis, targeting efforts

Our medical devices help more than 10,000 people have healthier hearts, improve quality of life for thousands of people living with chronic pain and movement disorders, and liberate more than 500,000 people with diabetes from routine ﬁngersticks.

jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer (CAD & Methodology)
jobs.description:
About Bitdeer Technologies Group

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for AI and Bitcoin mining infrastructure.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers and building AI computational infrastructure to support the AI revolution. Bitdeer handles complex processes involved in computing such as equipment procurement, transport logistics, data center design and construction, equipment management, and daily operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer has deployed data centers across multiple countries, including the United States, Norway, Bhutan, and Ethiopia.

To learn more, visit https://ir.bitdeer.com/

About The Role

We are seeking a highly specialized Senior Design Engineer with deep expertise in EDA tool capabilities and design methodologies to join our ASIC development team. In this role, you won't just be using tools to design circuits; you will be the architect of our design environment, optimizing flows, and pushing the absolute limits of our software infrastructure.

Our company engineers ultra-specialized hardware dedicated entirely to executing cryptographic hashing algorithms at extreme speeds and maximum energy efficiency. You will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between hardware design and tool automation, ensuring our specialized ASIC pipeline is perfectly tuned for next-generation cryptocurrency mining performance.

Key Responsibilities

EDA Flow Optimization: Own, develop, and maintain advanced digital and analog implementation flows, ensuring seamless integration of EDA tools across the design lifecycle.
Tool Capability Mastery: Act as the internal subject matter expert on Cadence ADE (Analog Design Environment) and digital implementation suites, optimizing tool configurations, variables, and features to maximize engineer productivity and silicon performance.
Physical Design Infrastructure: Drive and refine digital implementation flows utilizing Cadence Innovus or OpenROAD, focusing on floorplanning, placement, routing, and timing closure methodologies.
Automation & Scripting: Create, extend, and maintain robust automation scripts and internal tools using TCL, Python, BASH, and C to streamline design environments and eliminate manual bottlenecks.
Cross-Functional Support: Partner closely with analog and digital circuit designers to troubleshoot complex tool-related anomalies, license constraints, and flow failures.
Domain-Specific Alignment: Apply a foundational understanding of the Bitcoin ecosystem (including blockchain fundamentals and ASIC-boost protocols) to tailor design constraints and flow priorities toward cryptographic efficiency.

Qualifications

Education & Experience: Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, backed by proven hands-on experience in the integrated circuit (IC) design industry.
Tool Expertise (Analog): Deep, comprehensive understanding of Cadence ADE architecture, environment customization, and tool capabilities (beyond standard circuit simulation usage).
Tool Expertise (Digital): Intimate, production-level familiarity with digital physical design tool flows, specifically Cadence Innovus or the OpenROAD framework.
Expert Scripting & Programming: Fluency in scripting and programming languages essential to EDA automation, including TCL, Python, BASH, and C/C++.
Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of the Bitcoin mining ecosystem, cryptographic hashing constraints, and optimization techniques like ASIC-boost.
Problem Solving: A methodology-driven mindset with a passion for debugging complex software-hardware interactions and optimizing massive compute pipelines.

Bitdeer does not discriminate against employees or applicants based on conditions such as race, colour, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, marital and/or parental status, religion, political opinion, nationality, ethnic background or social origin, social status, disability, age, indigenous status, and union.

Full ownership and accountability of growing assigned key accounts of Top 30 Pharma companies.

University bachelor's degree, preferably in Life Science, Structural Biology, BioChemistry, Physics, Engineering.

Highly developed negotiation skills for customer interaction and closure of sales and other issues.
Excellent, enthusiastic, clear communication skills to a diverse audience is critical to the success of this position.
Systematic problem solving by working with customers and account team.
Presentation skills and creating materials for presentations to internal and external audiences.
Ability to work independently and in good cooperation within an account team.
Ability to perform and execute in a highly matrixed environment with a diverse group of stakeholders both internally and externally.

Miller-Heiman strategic and conceptual selling experience is highly desirable.
Experience in the drug discovery space in pharma/biotech industry.

Project management skills.

jobs.title: Data Science Lead
jobs.description:
**OpusClip** **is the world's No.1 AI video agent, built for authenticity on social media.**

We envision a world where everyone can authentically share their story through video, with no expertise needed. Within just 18 months of our launch, over 10 million creators and businesses have used OpusClip to enhance their social presence.

We have raised $50 million in total funding and are fortunate to have some of the most supportive investors, including SoftBank Vision Fund, DCM Ventures, Millennium New Horizons, Fellows Fund, AI Grant, Jason Lemkin (SaaStr), Samsung Next, GTMfund, Alumni Ventures, and many more.

Check out our latest coverage by Business Insider featuring our product and funding milestones, and our recognition as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2024.

Headquartered in Mountain View, we are a team of 100 passionate and experienced AI enthusiasts and video experts, driven by our core values:

* Be a Champion Team
* Prioritize Ruthlessly
* Ship fast, Quality Follows
* Obsess over customers

Be a part of this exciting journey with us!

**About the Role**
------------------

OpusClip is looking for a staff-level, product-oriented Data Science leader to build an effective and increasingly AI-native data function.

You will set priorities for a small Data team, personally lead our hardest analytical problems, improve how we measure product and business performance, and build systems that help teams make better decisions with less manual analytical work.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You may lead through direct management or technical leadership; formal people management is not required. We care more about your ability to lead through judgment, technical depth, and example.

You will work closely with Product, Growth, Finance, Engineering, and AI across product analytics, experimentation, user intelligence, data quality, growth measurement, AI data flywheels, and agentic analytics.

This expands the existing role from owning trusted metrics and analyses into setting direction and creating leverage across the Data function.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Lead the Data function**

* Set priorities for a small Data team and focus limited capacity on the highest-impact problems.
* Personally lead ambiguous or high-stakes analytical projects.
* Raise standards for metrics, experimentation, analytical quality, and decision-making.
* Lead and develop Data Scientists, analysts, and Data Engineers through technical direction and example.
* Reduce repetitive and reactive work by turning recurring problems into reusable systems and processes.

### **Drive product and business decisions**

* Analyze activation, retention, segmentation, monetization, user behavior, and lifetime value.
* Translate ambiguous business questions into rigorous analysis and clear recommendations.
* Identify opportunities where Data can directly improve key company metrics.
* Build stronger user profiling and segmentation to inform product strategy, operations, and company goal setting.
* Improve experimentation and causal measurement across Product and Growth.

The existing JD already emphasizes turning product and customer data into business decisions; this role owns that mandate at a broader level.

### **Improve data quality and measurement**

* Establish trusted definitions and validation for critical product and business metrics.
* Identify systematic issues across tracking, pipelines, transformations, tables, and dashboards.
* Partner with Data Engineering and Engineering to prevent recurring data problems rather than repeatedly fixing symptoms.
* Build reusable datasets, metric definitions, monitoring, and analytical frameworks that improve self-service.

You do not need to be a data infrastructure expert, but you should be technically strong enough to diagnose how data moves through a system, identify systemic failure modes, and work effectively with engineers to fix them.

### **Build Growth intelligence**

* Help Growth understand acquisition quality, retention, LTV, and the true value of different channels and customer segments.
* Improve performance marketing measurement beyond surface-level attribution toward experimentation and incrementality.
* Identify opportunities to improve CAC, conversion, retention, monetization, or other major business metrics.
* Build horizontal analytical tools and frameworks that enable Growth and Product teams to run better experiments and make faster decisions.

### **Partner with our AI teams**

* Support data curation, evaluation design, experimentation, and measurement for AI-powered product experiences.
* Identify product behavior that can become useful evaluation data, feedback signals, or failure cases.
* Connect AI quality with real user behavior and business outcomes.
* Strengthen the loop from **product usage data AI improvement better product**.

Model training experience is not required. The existing role already includes AI evaluation, curation, and online/offline measurement; this senior role is expected to make that collaboration systematic.

### **Build AI-native analytics**

* Use AI to automate recurring analytical work and improve the productivity of the Data team.
* Build trusted self-service tools for Product and business teams.
* Explore agentic systems that can detect unusual metric movements, identify contributing segments, generate hypotheses, and investigate likely causes.
* Help move the company from dashboards and one-off analysis toward proactive business intelligence.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Significant experience in data science, product analytics, decision science, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated Staff, Principal, Lead, or equivalent scope, regardless of formal title.
* Strong product and business judgment. You identify important questions instead of waiting for them to be assigned.
* Strong SQL and Python skills and a willingness to remain hands-on.
*

jobs.title: Staff Research Associate I-SRA1
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**

The Lundquist Institute for Biomedical Innovation at Harbor-UCLA Medical Center (TLI) is Los Angeles County's preeminent independent, not-for-profit biomedical research hub, excelling in transforming scientific breakthroughs into practical therapies. With a $90 million annual budget, TLI is home to over 150 investigators and 500 staff, advancing 600 projects in areas such as Infection and Immunity, Cancer, and Women's Health. Founded in 1952, the Institute continues to train physician-scientists and manage healthcare programs for 60,000 underserved families throughout South Los Angeles.

**SUMMARY**

The Staff Research Associate provides technical and operational support for biomedical research studies and laboratory activities. Working under the direction of senior laboratory personnel, this position assists with molecular biology, protein analysis, cell culture, and specimen-processing activities; supports data organization and documentation; and helps maintain efficient laboratory operations. The role requires a foundational understanding of biological sciences, particularly molecular biology, and the ability to follow established laboratory protocols while contributing to high-quality research activities.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Assist senior laboratory staff with molecular biology, protein, and cellular assays according to established protocols.
* Prepare samples, reagents, and materials necessary for laboratory experiments and research studies.
* Perform routine molecular biology procedures, including PCR setup, nucleic acid preparation, and related laboratory techniques.
* Support immunostaining, protein-based assays, and associated laboratory procedures.
* Assist with maintenance and expansion of mammalian cell cultures following laboratory protocols and quality standards.
* Receive, process, label, organize, and track human specimens and research samples in accordance with approved procedures and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain accurate laboratory records, databases, and research documentation.
* Organize, enter, and verify research data to support study reporting, analysis, and publication activities.
* Assist with next-generation sequencing (NGS) workflows and related laboratory procedures, as assigned.
* Operate laboratory equipment and report equipment issues or technical concerns to senior laboratory personnel.
* Monitor laboratory inventory, stock supplies, and assist with ordering laboratory materials and reagents.
* Follow all laboratory safety procedures, biosafety requirements, and institutional policies.
* Participate in laboratory meetings, training activities, and professional development opportunities.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and efficient laboratory environment.
* Perform other duties as assigned in support of laboratory operations and research program objectives.

**EDUCATION**

Bachelor's degree (BS or BA) in Biology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biomedical Sciences, Biotechnology, or a closely related scientific field required.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum of one (1) year of research laboratory experience, which may include academic, internship, or industry-based laboratory experience.
* Foundational knowledge of molecular biology principles and laboratory techniques.
* Experience performing or assisting with molecular and/or protein-based assays.
* Experience with laboratory documentation, data entry, and organization of research records.
* Experience handling biological samples in a laboratory environment.
* Ability to follow detailed laboratory protocols and standard operating procedures.
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to work independently on routine tasks while seeking guidance when appropriate.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary research team.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and basic data management tools.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with PCR setup, DNA/RNA extraction, or related molecular biology techniques.
* Experience with immunostaining, immunohistochemistry, immunofluorescence, or protein-based assays.
* Experience culturing mammalian cell lines.
* Experience working with human specimens in a research or clinical laboratory setting.
* Exposure to next-generation sequencing (NGS) assays or genomics-based laboratory techniques.
* Coursework or research experience in molecular biology, cancer biology, genetics, immunology, or related disciplines.

  *Please ensure your application is complete and signed;* ***incomplete submissions will not be considered****.*

  Background and Health Clearance Required

  Equal Opportunity Employer/Affirmative Action/Drug-Free Workplace

Precision Fluid Controls, Inc. designs, manufactures and tests components for launch vehicles and ground support applications—providing many types of valves including throttling valves, ball valves, check and relief valves, vent and relief valves, pressure reducing, both manual and dome loaded, regulators, sleeve valves, butterfly valves, solenoid valves plus many others.

**About the role:**

PFC is in search for a Clean Room Technician who will be responsible for assembling our aerospace valves and other components for launch vehicles (rockets!).

The role is a fully on-site role located in our Lincoln, CA offices and will report directly to the Production Manager.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

**What You’ll Do:**

In this role as a Clean Room Technician, you will work in a state-of-the-art clean room, supporting aerospace manufacturing operations. You will:

* Test aerospace components using air velocity and particle analyzers
* Perform dye penetrant (liquid penetrant) inspection to detect surface defects in aerospace components
* Set up and operate inspection and testing instrumentation
* Apply contamination control processes and techniques within clean room and laminar flow environments
* Collect and analyze particle samples
* Perform non-volatile residue (NVR) testing
* Support ultrasonic cleaning processes, including chemical analysis of ultrasonic baths
* Assist with passivation of metals and post-clean processing
* Maintain clean room standards and ensure compliance with contamination control procedures

**What You’ll Need:**

* Experience working in an ISO Class 7 clean room environment
* Experience or familiarity with dye penetrant inspection (DPI) or other non-destructive testing methods
* Familiarity with 5S and lean manufacturing procedures
* Ability to stand for extended periods — you will be on your feet most of the day
* Ability to work 100% on-site in the clean room environment

**Nice to Have:**

* Proven ability to follow detailed work instructions and procedures needed.
* Knowledge of contamination control processes and techniques, clean rooms, laminar flow environments, FOE/FOD, etc.
* Ability to read, interpret and understand written or oral requirements, procedures and specifications to perform assigned tasks.
* Requires the ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with the work team and those contacted in the course of work.
* Familiarity with 5S and lean procedures expected.
* Requires the ability and willingness to work overtime as necessary.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* Pay Range: $25.00 per hour. Commensurate with candidate experience.
* 401(k) + Company Matching
* Shifts: **(Sun-Wed/ Wed-Sat)**
* Company Paid Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance + Health Reimbursement Arrangement.
* Paid time off and Holidays

**Disclosures:**

**Physical Demands:**

* Adequate visual acuity — with or without correction — is required to detect fine defects.
* The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds.
* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

We are an equal opportunity employer that is committed to providing all with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status, age, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

**ITAR Compliance.**

Due to the nature of our business, this position may require compliance with the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a:

* U.S. citizen or national, or
* U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), or
* Refugee under 8 U.S.C. or
* 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. or
* 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Learn more about the ITAR .

jobs.title: Lab Technician
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Chemical Lab Technician I performs routine laboratory sampling, analysis, process-control support, and equipment checks for chemical milling, chemical cleaning, wastewater treatment, and related aerospace manufacturing processes. Working under general supervision and within established methods, the technician prepares samples and standards, performs wet-chemistry and instrumental tests, calculates and completes authorized chemical additions, maintains accurate records, and promptly reports out-of-limit results or equipment failures. The role supports safe operations, product quality, environmental compliance, production schedules, customer requirements and GKN quality standards.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Collects samples from process tanks, rinse systems, and wastewater treatment points according to approved sampling and safety requirements.
* Performs routine wastewater, wet-chemistry, volumetric, and process-control tests; compares results with established limits and reports abnormal conditions.
* Prepares samples, standards, blanks, and dilutions for AAS and ICP analysis; operates equipment using approved methods and records results.
* Tests chemical milling, Chem Brite, alkaline cleaning, and other process solutions for concentration, dissolved metals, and specified bath conditions.
* Calculates routine chemical additions using approved formulas or worksheets and verifies the tank, bath volume, chemical identity, and amount before making an authorized addition.
* Performs assigned tank changes, solution transfers, cleaning, fresh solution make-up, and routine maintenance according to approved procedures.
* Prepares, labels, stores, and controls reagents and analytical standards according to established concentration, expiration, storage, and identification requirements.
* Perform required equipment checks and maintenance; documents completion and reports equipment failures.
* Recognizes out-of-limit results, preserves original data, performs authorized preliminary checks, and promptly escalates potential out-of-specification results.
* Maintains complete analytical records, chemical inventory, and compliant laboratory and storage areas.
* Follows applicable safety, environmental, quality, customer, export-control, and government-contracting requirements and performs other related duties as assigned.
* Support Waste water treatment areas around the facility.

**Job Qualifications**
----------------------

* Associate degree in chemistry, chemical technology, environmental science, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of relevant education, laboratory training, and experience.
* Related laboratory, chemical-processing, wastewater, or hazardous-material experience.
* Ability to learn and consistently follow approved test methods, work instructions, safety requirements, and documentation practices in a repetitive production environment.
* Ability to work effectively both independently within assigned authority and as a collaborative team member.
* HAZWOPER certification, forklift certification, and a valid driver license are required when assigned to duties that require them. The company should specify whether certifications are required at hire or may be obtained within a defined period.
* Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office and the ability to use approved laboratory, inventory, and production systems.
* Must be able to perform work subject to applicable ITAR and program-access requirements. Any citizenship or work-authorization restriction must be reviewed and approved by Human Resources and legal/export-compliance personnel before posting.

* Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English sufficiently to follow safety instructions, technical methods, labels, specifications, and documentation requirements.
* Basic arithmetic and algebra skills for laboratory calculations, dilutions, concentrations, and chemical additions.
* Manual dexterity and visual acuity sufficient for accurate and safe laboratory work.
* Ability to stand or walk for extended periods, work near manufacturing equipment, and use required personal protective equipment.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds in accordance with safe-lifting practices and applicable accommodation requirements.
* Ability to work in areas with operational noise, chemical odors, temperature variation, and other conditions typical of a manufacturing and chemical laboratory environment.

**Compensation Data**
---------------------

The compensation range for this positing is between $29 - $31 per hour.

jobs.description:
**Laboratory Technician**

**Calipatria, CA**

**12+ months Contract**

**Job ID: 919**

**Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities (Essential Job Functions):**  
**Will the job involve driving? Yes.**  
**Will they drive a company vehicle? Yes.**  
**Also, can you tell me how much driving is required? about 20% of the day? It's basically to and from the lab to plant.Job Description**  
This position is responsible for the accurate, precise, safe, and efficient sample collection, , sample preparation, and analysis of geothermal liquids, gases and solids. Provide accurate, precise and timely reporting of results. Follow strict quality control procedures established through the QA/QC supervisor and adhere to California Environmental Protection Agency and United States Environmental Protection Agency's analytical procedures. This is an entry-level laboratory position that will perform work with close supervision and direction from the Lead Chemist.  
**Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Conduct sampling, prepare samples and perform analysis of geothermal solids, fluids and gases demonstrating proficiency in basic wet chemistry techniques (e.g. titrimetric, ion selective and gravimetric methods.)
* Prepare standards and quality control solutions, and ensure that analytical results are accurate and precise through the effective use of quality control methods.
* Perform calculations involving dilutions, normality, molarity and stoichiometry. Perform routine maintenance and standardization of laboratory equipment. Maintain lab and field equipment in a safe, clean and efficient condition.
* Demonstrate general use of word processing, spreadsheet, and other applicable computing skills.
* Must conduct data entry into the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) and various spreadsheets. Report results to appropriate personnel in a timely manner.
* Perform additional responsibilities as requested or assigned by laboratory supervisor, including special projects or potable water system support.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Must have a high school diploma or general education degree (GED) with one to three years of experience or related education in sample collection, sample preparation and analysis of liquids, gases and solids, or similar laboratory experience.
* Associate of Science degree in chemistry or other physical science with 0-1 year related experience highly desirable.
* Must have proficient computing skills, including the use of spreadsheets and word processors.
* Must have effective oral and written communication skills with the ability to read, analyze and interpret documents such as safety rules, environmental permits, standard operating procedures, and operating and maintenance procedures.
* Must be capable of issuing routine reports. Must be able to perform mathematical calculations used in the lab such as dilutions. Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as proportions, percentages, area, circumference and volume and to apply simple concepts of algebra.
* Effective ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and projects concurrently. Must be able to evaluate analytical results and note trends in data.
* A valid California driver's license is required.

Pay: $30.19 - $35.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

jobs.title: Research Assistant
jobs.description:
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a Post Baccalaureate Research Assistant to work on instrument and data calibration for the DSA test array at the Owens Valley Radio Observatory. The position involves hands-on work with a world-class instrument and its data; characterizing and fine-tuning receiver settings, solving for baseline and antenna-position errors, and measuring and improving the pointing accuracy of the telescopes. The position is well suited to someone early in their research career, for example, a recent graduate considering a PhD, or a student seeking research experience. You will receive mentorship from project scientists and engineers, contribute directly to the observatory’s scientific output, and have opportunities to co-author technical notes and publications.

**Essential Job Duties**

* Calibrate DSA observational data: derive and apply gain, bandpass, and delay solutions; solve for and correct errors in baselines and antenna positions.
* Improve instrument performance: characterize receiver behavior and fine-tune receiver settings to optimize sensitivity and stability.
* Improve telescope pointing: plan and conduct pointing measurements, analyze the results, and derive updated pointing models.
* Develop and maintain calibration software: write and extend Python analysis tools and pipeline components; keep code under version control and documented.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in physics, astronomy, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field (completed or expected by the start date).
* Proficiency in Python for scientific data analysis (e.g., NumPy/SciPy, working with large datasets).
* Some hands-on research experience — through coursework projects, a senior thesis, an internship (e.g., REU), or prior employment.
* Clear oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to work on-site at OVRO in Big Pine, CA, including occasional outdoor work at the antennas.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Coursework or experience in radio astronomy, interferometry, or signal processing.
* Familiarity with radio-astronomy software such as CASA, or with calibration concepts.
* Experience working in a Linux environment and with version control (git).
* Experience with laboratory instrumentation, RF/electronics test equipment, or antenna measurements.
* Experience with radio-frequency interference (RFI) identification and mitigation.

**Required Documents**

* Resume.
* Cover letter.

jobs.title: Research Associate
jobs.description:
Research Associate

**Cancer Genomics • Organoid Biology • Tumor Microenvironment**

**About the Lin Laboratory**
============================

The Lin Laboratory at USC studies the molecular mechanisms that drive cancer development, progression, immune evasion, and therapeutic response, with a particular focus on head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) and other upper aerodigestive cancers. Our research integrates cancer genomics and epigenomics with functional biology, patient-derived organoid models, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, and tumor immunology.

A major strength of the laboratory is the development and application of human organoid models. We use patient-derived tumor organoids and genetically defined organoid systems to reconstruct early malignant transformation, investigate genotype-to-phenotype relationships, model tumor-microenvironment interactions, and identify therapeutic vulnerabilities. These models are integrated with clinical specimens and multi-omic datasets to address biologically and clinically relevant questions.

The laboratory is embedded within the USC Head and Neck Center and the USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center, providing a highly collaborative environment with access to clinicians, patient specimens, advanced genomic technologies, and multidisciplinary expertise. Recent work from the laboratory has included studies of patient-derived HNSCC organoids, tumor immunity, epigenetic regulation, spatial tumor architecture, and mechanisms of metastasis and therapeutic response.

**Position**
============

We are seeking a motivated Research Associate to join the Lin Laboratory and contribute to NIH-funded studies of cancer biology. The successful candidate will participate in multidisciplinary projects spanning organoid biology, molecular and cellular biology, cancer genomics, tumor immunology, and functional studies of therapeutic response.

This position is particularly well suited for a scientist who wants to work at the interface of experimental and translational cancer research. Depending on experience and interests, projects may involve patient-derived organoid culture and characterization, molecular perturbation, drug-response studies, tumor-immune co-culture, flow cytometry, histology and imaging, and integration of experimental data with single-cell or spatial genomic analyses.

**Research Environment**
========================

The Lin Laboratory is part of a highly collaborative research community on the USC Health Sciences Campus. The laboratory works closely with investigators in the USC Head and Neck Center, USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center, and collaborating institutions. Team members have opportunities to develop expertise across experimental and computational approaches and to contribute to projects that connect fundamental mechanisms of cancer with patient-derived models and clinical questions.

**Qualifications**
==================

Candidates should have a PhD, MD, or equivalent doctoral degree in cancer biology, molecular biology, cell biology, genetics/genomics, immunology, bioengineering, biomedical sciences, or a related field.

Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

* Mammalian cell culture, primary cells, or organoid culture
* Molecular and cellular biology, including RNA/DNA analysis, western blotting, qPCR, immunofluorescence, or related methods
* Cancer biology, tumor immunology, or functional studies of therapeutic response
* Flow cytometry, microscopy, histology, or quantitative image analysis
* Genomics, transcriptomics, single-cell or spatial data analysis, or quantitative biology

Strong candidates will be intellectually curious, careful in experimental design and data interpretation, able to work independently while collaborating effectively with others, and interested in developing new experimental and analytical skills.

**Job Accountabilities**
========================

* Serves as a research trainee for the purpose of enhancing and developing research competencies. Participates in planning, designing, and conducting highly technical and complex research projects under the direction of a supervisor.
* Identifies, researches, compiles, and evaluates data sources, background information, and/or technology related to the area of specialization.
* Analyzes and evaluates research data and provides interpretations requiring significant knowledge of a specialized area of research.
* Searches the literature, utilizing available resources regarding new methodologies, and designs experiments accordingly.
* Contributes to the development of research documentation for publication and/or prepares technical reports, papers, and records.
* Operates and maintains sophisticated laboratory and scientific equipment.
* Performs other related duties as assigned or requested. The University reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

**Why Join the Lin Lab?**
=========================

This position offers the opportunity to work with human patient-derived models and clinically anchored datasets while gaining broad experience in modern cancer biology. Research Associate projects are designed to allow meaningful scientific ownership and contribution to publications and ongoing NIH-funded research programs.

**To Apply**
============

Please apply through the USC Careers system and include a curriculum vitae and a brief description of your research experience and interests. Candidates are encouraged to review the Lin Laboratory website before applying: https://sites.usc.edu/linlab/
